cards.vietnamese: Phô mai (thực phẩm làm từ sữa)
cards.example: We don’t have any cheese in the fridge.

cards.vietnamese: Quả đu đủ (trái cây nhiệt đới ruột cam)
cards.definition: A soft, sweet tropical fruit with orange flesh.
cards.example: Papaya grows on a tree in tropical climates.

cards.definition: A soft, white or brown thing that tastes great on pizza or in soups.
cards.example: I like fresh mushrooms on my pizza.

cards.definition: Full of things that help you stay healthy.
cards.example: Vegetables and fruits are very nutritious.

cards.vietnamese: Some: dùng câu khẳng định (+). Any: dùng câu phủ định (-) và nghi vấn (?)
cards.definition: Some is used in positive sentences. Any is used in negative sentences and questions.
cards.example: (+) There is some jam. (-) There isn’t any soup. (?) Is there any bread?

cards.vietnamese: Hạt ca cao (nguyên liệu làm sô-cô-la)
cards.definition: Seeds of a tropical tree used for making cocoa and chocolate.
cards.example: Chocolate is made from cacao beans.

cards.vietnamese: Dao rựa to bản (dùng để chặt quả ca cao)
cards.definition: Large heavy knives used as weapons or tools.
cards.example: Workers use machetes to cut the cacao pods.

cards.definition: To cook food (or beans) in an oven or over a fire.
cards.example: Factories roast the beans in big ovens.

cards.definition: Pressed or squeezed hard to break into small pieces or paste.
cards.example: The roasted beans are crushed into a smooth paste.

cards.definition: Fat obtained from cocoa beans, giving chocolate a creamy texture.
cards.example: Cocoa butter gives chocolate its smooth, creamy texture.

cards.vietnamese: Thể bị động: Được / Bị làm gì (is/are + V3/ed)
cards.definition: Focuses on the action and object rather than who did it.
cards.example: Apples are harvested every summer. The pods are opened carefully.

cards.vietnamese: A few + Danh từ đếm được số nhiều. A little + Danh từ không đếm được.
cards.definition: Countable: a few / few (books). Uncountable: a little / little (time, water).
cards.example: A few students like literature. They had a little time.

cards.definition: Soft cotton used for cleaning or planting seeds in a pot.
cards.example: Fold some cotton wool and put it inside the yoghurt pot.

cards.definition: Small parts produced by plants from which new plants grow.
cards.example: Put the seeds on top of the wet cotton wool.

cards.vietnamese: Từ nối chỉ thứ tự: Trước khi, Khi, Sau đó, Sau chuyện đó...
cards.definition: Words used to show the sequence or timeline in which actions happen.
cards.example: Before you start, clean the pot. Then fold the cotton wool.

cards.definition: A green vegetable with ridged skin and edible seeds.
cards.example: Okra is a popular, nutritious vegetable.

cards.vietnamese: Hỏi vị trí của đồ vật số nhiều: Where are the...? -> They are under/above/next to...
cards.example: Where are the set squares? They are in front of the pencil sharpener.

cards.term: How did you get to school?
cards.vietnamese: Bạn đến trường bằng phương tiện gì? -> I went by bus / bicycle / car.
cards.example: How did you get to school? I went to school by bus.

exercises.question: I have ________ bananas in my bag.
exercises.explanation: Câu khẳng định (+) nên ta dùng 'some'.

exercises.question: We don’t have ________ cheese left in the fridge.
exercises.explanation: Câu phủ định (don't have) phải dùng 'any'.

exercises.question: Is there ________ bread left on the dining table?
What is 'A soft, sweet tropical fruit with orange flesh'?
exercises.explanation: Đu đủ (papaya) là trái cây nhiệt đới ngọt, ruột màu cam.

exercises.question: Where do carrots and potatoes grow?
exercises.explanation: Củ cà rốt và khoai tây mọc và phát triển dưới lòng đất (in the ground).

exercises.question: Chocolate is made from ________, which grow on tropical trees.
exercises.explanation: Sô-cô-la được sản xuất từ hạt ca cao (cacao beans).

exercises.question: Workers use large knives called ________ to cut the cacao pods.
exercises.explanation: Công nhân dùng dao rựa lớn (machetes) để bổ vỏ quả ca cao.

exercises.question: The roasted cacao beans are ________ into a thick, smooth mixture.
exercises.explanation: Hạt rang xong được nghiền nát (crushed) thành hỗn hợp sánh mịn.

exercises.question: What ingredient gives chocolate its smooth, creamy texture?
exercises.explanation: Bơ ca cao (cocoa butter) tạo nên độ mịn màng, béo ngậy cho sô-cô-la.

exercises.question: There are ________ spices used in spicy dishes.
exercises.explanation: Spices là danh từ đếm được số nhiều, dùng 'many'.

exercises.question: There isn’t ________ sugar in dark chocolate.
exercises.explanation: Sugar là danh từ không đếm được, trong câu phủ định dùng 'much'.

exercises.question: Cacao beans ________ in warm tropical countries.
exercises.explanation: Dạng bị động số nhiều: are + V3 (grown).

exercises.question: Unscramble the letters to find a word for planting: S D E E S
exercises.explanation: S D E E S sắp xếp lại là SEEDS (hạt giống).

exercises.question: Unscramble the letters: I L S O
exercises.explanation: I L S O sắp xếp lại là SOIL (đất trồng).

exercises.question: ________ you put the seeds in, press the cotton wool down gently.
exercises.explanation: Trước khi gieo hạt, hãy ấn nhẹ bông gòn xuống (Before).

exercises.question: Water the seeds every day. ________ put the pot in a sunny place.
exercises.explanation: Từ nối diễn tả bước kế tiếp: Then (Sau đó).

exercises.question: ________ the plant is big enough, you can harvest and eat it.
exercises.explanation: When (Khi) cây đã đủ lớn, bạn có thể thu hoạch.

exercises.question: How did you get to school this morning? — I went to school ________ bus.
exercises.explanation: Đi bằng phương tiện giao thông dùng giới từ 'by' (by bus, by car).
